# hostereo_plans (Data Source)

Active plans with prices (USD). Public; no API key needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostereo_plans" "all" {}

output "plans" {
  value = { for p in data.hostereo_plans.all.plans : p.name => p.postpaid_monthly }
}
```
